title: Rey on The Run
description: Rey continues to search for an escape from Starkiller Base. At the end of a long walkway is a hangar bay full of TIE fighters. She prepares to steal a TIE fighter and fly back to safety. The only problem is the platoon of Stormtroopers between her and the hangar. She knows she is outnumbered, and before she can develop a plan to get past them, a second Stormtrooper platoon approaches from behind her.
